mapper.select: SELECT r.role_code FROM sys_user_role ur LEFT JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND r.status = 1

SELECT DISTINCT m.perms FROM sys_user_role ur INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.status = 1 LEFT JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON ur.role_id = rm.role_id LEFT JOIN sys_menu m ON m.id = rm.menu_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND m.perms IS NOT NULL AND m.perms != '' AND m.status = 1
SELECT role_id FROM sys_user_role WHERE user_id = #{userId}
